steps.name: launch_health

steps.lua: assert((function() for _,u in ipairs(Ext.Mod.GetLoadOrder()) do if u == '82c1f53b-5ed3-4e2e-95f5-f84ca6ff0c81' then return true end end return false end)(), 'Transmog Enhanced Revamped present in load order')
steps.name: assertion_1

steps.lua: assert(type(Mods) == 'table' and Mods.TransmogEnhanced ~= nil, 'TransmogEnhanced ModTable bootstrapped')
steps.name: assertion_2

steps.lua: assert((function() local host=Osi.GetHostCharacter(); if not host then return false end; local e=Ext.Entity.Get(host); if not e then return false end; local c=e.Health or e.DisplayName; if not c then return false end; local ok,s=pcall(Ext.Types.Serialize, c); return ok and type(s) == 'table' end)(), 'component Serialize executes on live host-character component')
steps.name: assertion_4

steps.lua: assert((function() local e=Ext.Entity.Get(Osi.GetHostCharacter()); return e ~= nil and type(e.CreateComponent) == 'function' and type(e.Replicate) == 'function' end)(), 'entity CreateComponent and Replicate methods exposed')
steps.name: assertion_5

steps.lua: assert((function() local id=Ext.Events.Tick:Subscribe(function() end); local ok=type(id) == 'number'; Ext.Events.Tick:Unsubscribe(id); return ok end)(), 'Tick event subscribe roundtrip executes')
steps.name: assertion_6

steps.lua: assert(type(Ext.Osiris.RegisterListener('RequestProcessed', 3, 'after', function() end)) == 'number', 'RequestProcessed Osiris listener registration executes')
steps.name: assertion_7

steps.lua: assert((function() local host=Osi.GetHostCharacter(); return host ~= nil and Osi.GetTemplate(host) ~= nil end)(), 'Osi.GetTemplate resolves on host character')
steps.name: assertion_8
